title: Comte d'Affry (The Hague) to the Marquis de Stainville at Vienna, August 1757 (DECODE R1071)

steps.what: DECODE records R1052-R1076 and R2067 fetched with the session cookie (images and digit transcriptions), R1071 among them.
Group-frequency cosine between letters splits the series into three codes (A Jan-Feb 1757, B Apr 1757-Jan 1758, C R1071).
R1071 (to Stainville, Aug 1757) tested against the key: nonsense, a different code.
DECODE harvest (list.json, views_b.jsonl) searched for other d'Affry, Stainville or Choiseul records or keys: only the inv. 192 letters and a 1763-64 Choiseul record (BL Add MS 32263); no key.

Entry split from affry1757 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R1071 is in code C, not the code of the other ten letters; cipher_C.txt measured (761 tokens, 357 distinct). Image P1 compared with the parse for the snip: 240 for 24, a merged token.

outcome.method_basis: R1071 is in a code of its own (code C): the key rebuilt for d'Affry's other 1757 letters gives nonsense, there is no decipherment among the images, and no key record was found.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/affry1757c/cipher_C.txt: 761 code groups, none with a value.

gaps.detail: a different code (code C) from the rest of inv. 192; no decipherment among the images; NA 1.01.50 inv. 221/223 not digitised; no key record on DECODE

outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from affry1757, which keeps the ten letters in d'Affry's 1757 code (key rebuilt from Lyonet's decipherments, read in part).

prior.where: Probably among Lyonet's decipherments, Nationaal Archief 1.01.50 inv. 223 (d'Affry to B., Jul 1757 - Dec 1758), not digitised and not seen

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
